evidence.head: a6ede436c721b668c232f08a95fbe1e7411cbb77
evidence.observed_bug: all 3458 stable Text observations in Score Comparison and 4305 in Symbolic Equivalence report root rgb [0,0,0] in JSONL, although decoded native MP4 screenshots visibly show light-colored text; Text group-level get_color() is not the effective visible SVG glyph fill color.

objective: Replace invalid root Text color getter with measured Manim CE SVG leaf path fill RGB and opacity, without altering WCAG >=4.5 threshold or patching rendered pixels.
method: At construct time, inspect actual Text SVG leaf VMobjects with points, deduplicate fill-color candidates and fail closed if no visible valid glyph color can be measured
Serialize provenance and all distinct glyph fill RGB candidates; validator checks WORST-CASE contrast of every candidate, no averaging/hiding low-contrast glyphs
Keep construct-time 1.07 geometry envelope, no claim of exact animated style tracking
Smoke must demonstrate measured bright Text glyph contrast >=4.5 against real dark background and 15+ telemetry rows
Rerun 3 frozen host-synthetic fixtures; retain V375 object collision blocking, permit genuine color failures based on glyph values
Native MP4 decoded-pixel proxy and no visual-quality GO until full evidence
acceptance: CI exact-head PASS for offline negatives, smoke H264 and actual SVG glyph RGB, correct per-case outcomes with telemetry hashes, at least one physically rendered creative candidate. Zero claims of complete dynamic glyph/pixel correctness.
non_goals: changing source creative storyboards or native MP4 artifacts
source_classification: This is an instrument measurement bug; low readability of individual glyphs may still be real and must remain NO_GO when witnessed.
